matters.title: Motion approving the purchase of replacement draft tube mixer parts for digesters at the Water Pollution Control Plant from Ovivo USA, LLC of Salt Lake City, Utah in the amount of $60,141.60. [All Wards]

attachments.name: Cover Sheet
attachments.text:
City of Davenport
Department: Public Works Action / Date
Contact Info: Nicole Gleason | 563-326-7734 8/27/2025
Subject:
Motion approving the purchase of replacement draft tube mixer parts for digesters at the Water
Pollution Control Plant from Ovivo USA, LLC of Salt Lake City, Utah in the amount of
$60,141.60. [All Wards]
Recommendation:
Pass the Motion.
Background:
A sole source procurement justification for Ovivo USA, LLC is on file with the Purchasing
Division for the purchase of draft tube mixer parts.
This purchase will provide replacement parts for draft tube mixers at the Water Pollution
Control Plant. The draft tube mixers are used to mix the sludge in the digesters to optimize
conditions for anaerobic bacteria to break down organic matter, leading to higher biogas yields
used to power the plant generators.
Funding for this purchase is from the Water Pollution Control Plant operating budget.
Attachments:
None

Resolution offered by Alderwoman Newton.

City of Davenport
Department: Public Works Action / Date
Contact Info: Chief Carlsten | 563-326-7906 | 1/15/2025
Subject:
Resolution ratifying the purchase of refurbishment services for Fire Truck 3 in the amount of
$262,946.11 from Legacy Fire Apparatus of Shorewood, Illinois, CIP #24021. [All Wards]
Recommendation:
Adopt the Resolution.
Background:
The Fire Department apparatus fleet required refurbishment of one of the 70' aerial ladder
trucks to better align the replacement schedule and funding. The City owns two 2002 Sutphen
MT70 models and Truck 3 was selected for refurbishment.
Legacy Fire Apparatus is a sole source vendor and an authorized distributor of Sutphen Fire
Apparatus. Legacy completed a refurbishment and overhaul of one 2002 Sutphen MT70. The
total cost of the refurbishment is $262,946.11 and will extend the service life of this unit to
2035.
Attachments:
1. Resolution
2. Invoice

attachments.name: Cover Sheet
attachments.text:
City of Davenport
Department: Public Works Action / Date
Contact Info: Chief Carlsten | 563-326-7906 | 1/8/2025
Subject:
Resolution ratifying the purchase of refurbishment services for Fire Truck 3 in the amount of
$262,946.11 from Legacy Fire Apparatus of Shorewood, Illinois, CIP #24021. [All Wards]
Recommendation:
Adopt the Resolution.
Background:
The Fire Department apparatus fleet required refurbishment of one of the 70' aerial ladder
trucks to better align the replacement schedule and funding. The City owns two 2002 Sutphen
MT70 models and Truck 3 was selected for refurbishment.
Legacy Fire Apparatus is a sole source vendor and an authorized distributor of Sutphen Fire
Apparatus. Legacy completed a refurbishment and overhaul of one 2002 Sutphen MT70. The
total cost of the refurbishment is $262,946.11 and will extend the service life of this unit to
2035.
Attachments:
1. Resolution
2. Invoice

Subject:
Motion awarding a contract for repairs to Fire Truck 1 to Legacy Fire Apparatus of Shorewood,

Pass the Motion.

A sole source procurement justification is on file with the Purchasing Division. Legacy Fire
